summary: The paper presents the APPLE-DSE algorithm for microarchitecture design space exploration, but contains no code availability statement, no GitHub link to the authors' code, and no indication that code will be released. Extensive searching across GitHub repo names, READMEs, code contents, and web searches found no repository belonging to the authors. The only GitHub link in the paper is to riscv-software-src/riscv-tests, a benchmark suite used in evaluation, which contains no HLS designs. No authors' code repository was found for this paper.
